title: MemoryAlias
description: One legacy-ID alias: the durable v1→v2 id binding the G1.2 migration persists so existing decisions, feedback, supersede successors, and candidate→record promotions keep resolving after a memory-1 record is re-addressed under its re-seeded memory-2 content id. The optional scope/appliesTo/meta fields carry the v1 record's placement, reattachment targets, and open meta across the migration — the closed v2 envelope has no counterpart for them, so the binding is the only place the as-believed v1 state survives a local/global line replacement. They are additive optional fields (schemaVersion stays '1'; pre-enrichment aliases that omit them remain valid).
